title: 60% off Voyarc Pro 1 Year Subscription US$15.60 (Limit 100, Was US$39) – Animated Flight Route Map & Video Maker @ Voyarc
body:
Deal: 60% off Voyarc Pro 1 Year Subscription US$15.60 (Limit 100, Was US$39) – Animated Flight Route Map & Video Maker @ Voyarc

[Nalar] I think I know where this post is going……Hello AI Slop thread friends!
[auauau7] haha yeah reading it back the blurb is a bit much. it's just this: voyarc.app/route/SYD-SIN-LHR as an example or type your flights, it draws them, you can click the Fly button to view the animated flight path, and you can also export the pic/video. that's the whole thing
[Lizard Spock] animated flight-route maps
No idea what you're talking about
kind you see on TikTok and Reels
Yeah, that didn't help
[auauau7] yeah that's on me, terrible description. you know the little map with the curved line and a plane going from Sydney to London? it makes that. put in your flights, it draws them and gives you the distance, and you can save it as a pic or a short clip for a trip post. have a look: voyarc.app/route/SYD-SIN-LHR for example, you can click the Fly button to view the animated flight path
[Lizard Spock] Got it. But then what does one use it for?
[auauau7] two kinds of people so far.
avgeeks:
import your flightradar24 log and it maps every flight you've ever taken, or plays a year back month by month, or drop in the track of the flight you were on and watch it race the great circle.
and people making trip videos:
a short clip of the route for the start of a vlog or a reel, or a square pic of the itinerary for the trip post. same map the tracker sites show, just yours, animated, and you can take it with you.
if none of that is you then no, you don't need it. the free tier of my app does all of it anyway
[tm001] 2 Questions:
1) What does warrant the subscription? Doe sit allow me to store my routes/view or something somewhere? Does it use some external AI?
2) What is it good for? It even does not have the actual fligh routes. Just a geometric line. (at least on your given example)
I do not downvote it, just don't see the point of the app. Maybe I did not get it, pls explain :-)
[auauau7] thanks mate, very good questions:
1. no AI anywhere, it's just maths. the line is the great circle between the two airports, and the distance is measured on the real shape of the earth rather than a sphere. the subscription pays for the map tiles and hosting. what it actually gets you:
- exports with no wordmark and at 4K, NASA day and night satellite imagery in the file,
- and it saves your stuff: route lists as collections, and your whole flight log with dates, so the map of everywhere you've flown or last year's review opens again without the file.
- free maps the first 25 legs of an import, Pro does the whole log. nothing on screen changes, all of that is free.
on privacy : a csv or track file is read in your browser and never uploaded. nothing is stored unless you're on Pro and press add to my logbook , and then it's only your legs and dates, no additional information will be saved on your account
2) fair, on the example it's the shortest path, not the ATC route. that's the line the distance is measured on. if you want the path you actually flew, import the track using the Track option just right below the Night map (you can upload flightaware's export to google earth kml , a gpx, or an fr24 flight csv) and it draws that over the great circle and tells you how much further the plane really went.
who it's for : avgeeks mapping their logbook, and people who want a short route clip for a trip video. if neither is you, it's not for you, and that's fine
[GeoK] so like one of many like this https://maprecap.com/travel-map-animation/ but I get to pay for it?
[auauau7] had a look, that's a nice one for a city to city trip with trains and drives in it, and it's free, so if that's the video you want, use it.
my app is narrower, it's only about flights . you type airport IATA codes , it draws the great circle and gives you the distance, spins it on a globe, imports your flightradar24 log or the track of a flight you were on, and plays a year of flying back month by month.
the animated export is free here too , 1080p with a small wordmark. the code is for 4K without the wordmark and the satellite imagery , which is what pays the tile bills. nobody has to pay to make the video
